name: Instant Emoji Reactions
author: Usama Khalid

sections.description:
Add emoji reactions to posts and custom post types, allowing both logged-in and guest users to react. The plugin allows users to express their feelings using emojis such as Agree, Disagree, Angry, Love, and Laugh, and it stores the reactions for each post type.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the emoji-reactions folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the [instant_emoji_reactions] shortcode in your posts or pages to display the reactions.
  4. You can manage the emoji reactions via the plugin settings in the WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

Simply activate the plugin, and use the [instant_emoji_reactions] shortcode in any post or page where you want the reactions to appear.

Can I customize the emoji reactions?

Yes, you can customize the emoji reactions in the plugin’s settings page.

Can guest users react to posts?

Yes, guest users can react to posts without needing to log in. The plugin stores their reactions under the dynamic user ID which plugin generates and store in cookie.
sections.changelog:
1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Added support for emoji reactions on posts and custom post types.
  • AJAX-based reactions for logged-in and guest users.
  • Reactions stored in the database and updated when users change their reaction.
